page.layout: One printed page, title page, printed upside down on the scan. Top: a large title in capitals, then a smaller line, the author's name in spaced capitals, and a line of description. Middle: a woodcut emblem of a tree with a figure and a deer-like animal. Bottom: place and printer, then the date.
page.notes: The scan is rotated 180 degrees; the text was transcribed in reading order as printed. The woodcut shows a tree with a figure standing at left and an animal at right; it is an illustration and not transcribed. Line 6 and line 7 of the description are uncertain: the letters are faint and the line breaks around "in" and "Academia" are doubtful. The date is read as cIↄ Iↄ c lxxii, i.e. MDCLXXII, with a doubtful final "lxxii" marked [?].
